MODEL_SELF_REPORT cannot independently score debugging transfer.
C-007 grants no runtime, training, automatic memory-commit, promotion, deployment, or external-action authority.

Baseline/transfer pairs reject additional lesson candidates that would confound attribution.
Ruff and strict mypy must pass on the user Windows environment before commit or push.
